text: player
Journey's End
Shen
I am Shen... one of the dragon clan.
When I was little, I was washed ashore by a storm. It was the master of Mahjong Soul Shrine who saved me.
The shrine master nursed me back to health, cared for me, and gave me a priceless gift...
This Sacred Tile. It's said to possess the miraculous power to turn fantasy into reality.
I was told that my journey was far from over.
And so, I set out.
True to those words, the world beyond held one new horizon after another.
Shen wove her memories into the fog, hoping to share them in vivid detail when she returned.
Though she journeyed alone, knowing someone was waiting for her kept her from ever feeling lonely.
And yet...
Huh?
Where... am I?
I'm... I'm back...
...Where are you?
No, you said you'd be here when I came back. We were supposed to share our stories...
This must be what humans call a dream. It can't be real.
I just need to sleep... Just a little nap, and everything will be fine when I wake up.
So, before she could make sense of the dull ache in her chest, she let her eyes drift shut.
Surely, when she opened them again, everything would be just as it was...
I don't know what happened after that.
Then you all barged in and tried to take my Sacred Tile...
It's a token of our promise! I won't let anyone take it!
Leia
I see. Her emotional distress during sleep must have caused both the Sacred Tile's power and her innate fog magic to spill out unchecked.
Even this very island might not actually exist...
How heartbreaking.
Yuzu
Argh... They say dragons live so long that a few centuries must feel like a blink to them.
Kaavi
But against the brief span of human fate, that blink is an eternity.
Considering our time with Lin Lang, that rings all too true.
So that person... my friend... is gone?
Her question plunges everyone into silence.
Ichihime
Oh no, nyaa... I don't know what to say anymore, nyaa...
Telling her the raw truth now might be too cruel.
No.
Frieren
Perhaps we could try THAT spell.
Everyone
Huh?
Looks like that special spell is our only shot right now.
Which one, nyaa...?
Ah! Could it be...?
Well then, here goes.
<color=#6CC2B6>Spell that creates wind, blossoms, snow, and moonlight out of thin air!</color>
A mahjong tile glowing with the same radiance as the Sacred Tile materializes in Frieren's hand.
The very spell found in the chest hidden deepest within the ruins – now cast for the first time.
Th-this is...?!
I remember this... It's...
That person used magic just like this back at the Shrine to teach me how to guide the fog...!
But no matter how hard I tried, I could never recreate it... So I hid it where no one could find it...
How can you...?
I wonder why, too.
I didn't expect my first attempt to yield such a wondrous result either.
Heh... Humans are just such selfish creatures, aren't they?
Even long after they're gone, they leave these peculiar marks carved deep into your memory.
It's fine if you can't master it right away. Take it with you on your journey.
The things you don't understand today will shine like beacons somewhere down the road.
String them together like pearls, and you might just discover a whole new perspective.
When that day comes, I know you'll be smiling.
Sniff...
Waaah–!!!
Liar.
That person used to tease the little dragon, saying a dragon's tears turned into valuable pearls.
But determined to prove herself mature and independent, she had never shed a single tear.
I told you... They don't turn into pearls... You liar.
Once Shen has calmed down, we begin packing up our makeshift camp.
With her lending a hand, the work goes much faster.
You can take the Sacred Tile with you.
Are you sure about this?
Isn't that what you treasure most?
Yeah... It was entrusted to me, but it ultimately belongs to the Shrine.
That person wouldn't want me to be a selfish child.
We can't blame you for what happened.
Though long-lived by human standards, she's still very much a child at heart.
None of the trouble she caused was born of malice, so there's no need to be too hard on her.
Actually, there's another reason.
{var:player_nickname}, could you be...?
No, that can't be right... Human lifespans are...
What is it?
N-nothing... I'm just overthinking things...
Even if the aura feels so familiar, it couldn't be...
For some reason, she shrinks back into a timid stance once more.
Anyway, I'll gather up all the fog. I won't cause any more trouble.
Without the mist disrupting mana, and with the Shrine's wish granted...
Madam Frieren and the others will be able to return to their world safely.
Madam, huh...
Hard to say there's anything wrong with that.
What about you after this?
After this... I'll probably carry on with my journey.
Won't you come visit the Shrine?
Yeah, who knows when we'll see each other again, nyaa!
Frie, you guys should stay over too, nyaa! As the priestess, I'll show you top-tier hospitality!
I'm... not ready yet.
Revisiting familiar places after everything has changed... I want to wait until I've grown enough to stand on my own – and can face it in my true form.
Maybe many years from now, I'll drop by for a visit. I'll be in your care then, Miss Ichihime.
Suddenly talking like a grown-up, nyaa!
Maybe this fog-formed body is simply unstable?
Well then, farewell, my friends.
...Safe journey.
To you as well.
Ichihime the Hero, the master witch and her apprentices, an innocent Demon King, and adventurers from another world –
Their shared story draws to a close here.
And afterward...
Fern
Mr. Stark, please stop trying to polish the tile in your hand.
It is not going to turn into a Dora.
Stark
Help me out, Frieren! I'm just a few points away from taking first place!
Hang on, {var:player_nickname} gave me an ancient grimoire that seems to record mystical magic...
No, actually... that's just a game log...
And so, after the adventure comes a return to peaceful, ordinary life.
...Or so it seems.
Deep within Mahjong Soul Shrine rests the treasured Sacred Tile.
From it, a wisp of fog tinged with a different hue quietly begins to seep out...
It was likely her familiar aura that the dragon sensed, causing it to manifest in her likeness before us.
That person asked me to carry the Sacred Tile, record everything I saw along the way, and come back someday so we could trade stories.
I was only gone for a mere few hundred years... Why has everything changed?
Isn't there some spell that might work?!
As soon as I find the spell to make non-Dora tiles sparkle like gems, I'll help you out.
